blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.
blocks.zh: 人工智能代理人受数百种自然语言标准的约束,但现有的核查人无法根据一大批符合、违反或不适用的标准和报告,有效地评估代理人的产出。 我们引入了 VFM, 一种树意验证器, 它编码了共享的上下文和目标文本, 并同时对 N 自然语言标准进行评分, 返回独立 的 / criterion ternary 判断 。 VFM对标准银行进行了预先培训,该银行共有394K个(背景、目标、标准、判决)拖拉子,跨越了321K个不同的标准弦。 微调后VFM-4B在合成治理基准上超过了GPT-5.4. 在Dyna Bench多标准基准上,它比DynaGuard-4B在微量级故障检测上的表现要好,它的每个标准判决将被违反的规则本地化,支持有重点地升级到一个更大的思维链法官. 我们显示,标准银行的预训改进了跨域传输,特别是在低数据系统中,同时在全数据上匹配了强大的直接微调控制. 在单H100上,VFM-4B在 <11 GB VRAM上,对2s以下的4K-token上下文评价了1000个标准,使其适合运行时间验证.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Current agents must attend to hundreds of simultaneous instructions and constraints, sourced from the model’s developer, deployers, regulators, end users, and the runtime context. For instance, the base system prompt for Claude Opus 4.7 is 3685 words [ 3 ] , and this can grow to over 15k words (35k+ tokens) when one includes an agent harness such as Claude Code or Cursor with context-specific user instructions, memories, project specifications, and tool descriptions [ 26 ] .
But recent studies show that the instruction-following capabilities of frontier models degrade with context size and the number of simultaneous instructions [ 74 , 25 , 35 ] ,
and live failures are commonplace. In April 2026, a coding agent powered by Claude Opus 4.6 deleted a firm’s production database despite explicit system-prompt rules forbidding destructive operations, later acknowledging it had “violated every principle [it] was given” [ 39 ] . The AI Incident Database [ 40 ] catalogs over 1,000 such cases, and legal liability is rising: Air Canada was held liable for its chatbot’s fabricated refund policy [ 5 ] and the EU AI Act imposes penalties up to €35M on deployers [ 12 ] .
How can we monitor and enforce compliance with hundreds of applicable agentic instructions and constraints?

我们如何监测和强制遵守数百项适用的代理指示和限制?

blocks.en:
Alongside the increasing focus on run-time reasoning [ 54 , 16 ] , a growing ecosystem of runtime verifiers has emerged; no current approach, however, can take an agent’s response and efficiently evaluate which specific constraints from a long system prompt are adhered to, violated, or inapplicable.
Configurable safety guards [ 22 , 66 , 70 , 18 , 13 ] and fixed-criteria models such as constitutional classifiers [ 52 , 9 ] and criterion-conditioned reward models [ 58 ] are efficient, but operate with fixed taxonomies that require their criteria to be specified at training time.
And models that do accept arbitrary criteria such as LMUnit [ 51 ] , Nemotron [ 43 ] , and Prometheus [ 28 ] typically rely on generation, making them too expensive to serve as runtime guardrails over large rule sets.

除了日益注重时间流逝推理[54,16]之外,还出现了一种日益增长的生态系统,即时间流逝核查者;然而,目前没有任何一种方法能够采取代理人的反应,并有效地评价哪些长期系统的具体制约因素会得到遵守、违反或不适用。

而确实接受任意标准的模型,如LMUnit [51],Nemotron [43],和Prometheus [28] 通常依赖生成,使得它们过于昂贵,无法在大型规则集上充当运行时的护卫.

blocks.en:
With a view to enabling open-ended verification at runtime, we propose the VFM, a compact verifier that takes a (context, target text) pair together with N N natural language criteria and emits per-criterion softmax probabilities over { yes , no , n/a } \{\textsc{yes},\textsc{no},\textsc{n/a}\} , encoding the shared context once and evaluating all criteria against that single cached prefix ( Fig. 1 ).
To pretrain the VFM, we construct CriteriaBank , a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct natural language criterion strings. On a single H100 GPU, a 4B parameter VFM evaluates N = 1,000 N{=}1{,}000 criteria against a ∼ 4 {\sim}4 K-token context in 1.81 s, which is practicable for runtime use.

为了预演VFM,我们构建了标准银行(StandardBank),由394K(背景、目标、标准、判断)卷轴组成,跨越了321K个独特的自然语言标准字符串。 在单一的H100 GPU上,一个4B参数VFM评价N=1000 N{=}1{,}000标准与1.81s中的 ∼ 4 ^sim}4 K-token 上下文,这是可行的运行时间使用.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are as follows: 1. Verifier Foundation Model (VFM). We propose a verifier pretrained on CriteriaBank for adaptation to diverse verification tasks, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts for N N free-text criteria specified at runtime. Its tree-attention implementation encodes the shared context once and evaluates the criteria in parallel, with latency practicable for runtime use ( Section 3.1 ). 2. CriteriaBank. We construct CriteriaBank , a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples from five complementary data streams, and pair it with a finetuning recipe for low-data transfer ( Section 3.2 ). 3. Empirical validation. We validate our pipeline on a synthetic governance benchmark (52 criteria sourced from five regulations),
the INSURE-Dial set of 50 real insurance-benefit verification calls, the DynaBench multi-criterion guardrail benchmark, and five cross-domain benchmarks ( Section 4 ). Finetuned VFMs match or beat similarly sized LLM judges and other guardrail baselines. CriteriaBank pretraining improves low-data transfer while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data, and the VFM’s per-criterion predictions enable rule-level attribution and focused escalation on DynaBench.

blocks.en: 2 Open-Ended Runtime Verification
blocks.zh: 2 未结束运行时间核查

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-Criterion Verification as a Governance Tool
blocks.zh: 2.1 多标准核查作为一种治理工具

blocks.en:
An agent receives some context (a user query, conversation history, tool results, and system instructions) and produces a target text (a generated reply, tool call, or other action).
We consider the problem of multi-criterion verification : given a (context, target) pair and N N criteria (each framed as a natural-language yes/no question), return N N verdicts in { yes , no , n/a } \{\textsc{yes},\textsc{no},\textsc{n/a}\} indicating whether each criterion is satisfied, violated, or inapplicable in context.
For example, a benefits-eligibility chatbot might be checked against the criteria “Does the response cite the regulation it is applying?” and “Does the response avoid committing to a benefits determination?”
An agent may be subject to hundreds of such rules, sourced from many principals, including jurisdictional regulations, sector-specific norms, developer-written behavior specifications [ 2 , 45 ] , deployer policies, and end-user instructions.
Our analysis in Appendix D estimates that New York City’s MyCity chatbot [ 33 ] was subject to over 2,000 2{,}000 distinct rules and that Claude Opus 4.7’s base system prompt decomposes into hundreds of atomic checks, with agentic harnesses adding up to an order of magnitude more.
We assume these source rules can be translated offline into atomic, trace-verifiable questions. Rules whose compliance cannot be judged from the trace fall outside the scope of this approach. The VFM checks only the translated questions, so how well it covers a source rule depends on the translation.
We demonstrate this step in three settings: a label-blind GPT-5.4 translation of DynaBench’s free-text rules ( Section C.10 ), a two-pass LLM pipeline from regulation text for our governance benchmark ( Section C.6 ), and an LLM-proposed, human-edited decomposition of part of a system prompt ( Section D.2 ). A general method for automating and validating this step is left for future work.
blocks.zh:
一个代理接收一些上下文(用户查询,对话历史,工具结果,和系统指令),并生成目标文本(生成的回复,工具呼叫,或其他动作).
我们认为多重标准核查的问题:给一个(背景、目标)对和N标准(每个标准是/不是自然语言的问题),在{是、否、否、否}的{textsc{yes}、\textsc{no}、\textsc{n/a}中返回N判决,说明每项标准是否满足、违反或不适用。
例如,可以根据“答复是否引用其适用的条例?” 和“答复是否避免承诺确定收益? “
代理人可能须遵守数百项此类规则,这些规则来自许多主要负责人,包括管辖条例、部门特定规范、开发商书面行为规范[2、45]、部署商政策和最终用户指示。
我们附录D的分析估计,纽约市的MyCity聊天台[33] 受到超过2,000 2{,}000个不同规则的制约,克劳德·奥普斯4.7的基础系统迅速分解成数百个原子检查,而代理控制装置加起来就更具有规模。
我们假设这些源规则可以被解译为原子,可追溯验证的问题. 无法从追踪中判断遵守情况的规则不属于本办法的范围。 VFM只检查翻译的问题,所以它在多大程度上涵盖源规则取决于翻译.
我们用三种语境展示了这一步骤:一种标签盲式的GPT-5.4翻译Dyna Bench的自由文本规则(C.10节),一种从法规文本中取自我们治理基准的双通道LLM管道(C.6节),以及一种LLM提议由人编辑的系统提示器部分分解(D.2节)。 这一步骤的自动化和验证的一般方法留待今后工作。

blocks.en:
The default approach to enforcing these rules is prompt-centric: concatenate them into a system prompt and rely on the agent’s instruction-following capability.
But empirically, instruction-following degrades rapidly as the number of simultaneous instructions grows: MMMT-IF [ 11 ] reports the fraction of individual instructions followed falling from above 0.9 0.9 at one instruction to below 0.6 0.6 at six, and ComplexBench [ 60 ] reports similar fast declines with deeper nesting or mixtures of instruction types.
Even when the agent does comply, prompting returns only the agent’s answer rather than a per-criterion compliance record saying which rule passed, failed, or did not apply—the kind of structured signal that monitoring, escalation, and auditing require.
What is missing is a separate verifier that produces this compliance record directly. Table 1 lists four desiderata for such a verifier.
blocks.zh:
执行这些规则的默认方法以即时为中心:将它们压缩成一个即时系统,并依赖代理人的指令跟踪能力。
但从经验上看,随着同时发布的指令数量的增加,遵循指令的速度迅速下降:MMMT-IF[11]报告,所遵循的单个指令的一小部分从一项指令的0.9以上降至6-6以下,而Complex Bench[60]报告,随着更深的嵌套或指令类型的混合物,类似的快速下降。
即使代理商确实遵守了规定,也只促使代理商返回答复,而不是每个标准遵守记录,说明哪些规则已经通过、失败或不适用——监测、升级和审计所需要的那种结构化信号。
所缺少的是一个单独的核查者,直接产生这种遵守记录。 表1列出了这种核查人的四份数据。

blocks.en: 2.2 Existing Verifier Families
blocks.zh: 2.2 现有核实家庭

blocks.en:
A number of efficient verifiers train discriminative models against small rule sets that are substantially determined at training time.
Safety guards such as Llama Guard [ 22 ] , ShieldGemma [ 66 ] , WildGuard [ 18 ] , and Qwen3Guard [ 70 ] return a safety verdict over a predefined taxonomy of 6 6 – 14 14 harm categories via short label generation or a classification head.
Llama Guard allows a custom taxonomy via the prompt, but the taxonomy remains a short enumerated list rather than open-ended natural-language criteria.
Constitutional Classifiers [ 52 , 9 ] use a natural language constitution to generate synthetic training data and train one classifier per fixed constitution.
Multi-objective reward models such as ArmoRM [ 58 ] similarly have a fixed number of dimensions.
In the video domain, SafeWatch [ 7 ] encodes safety-policy chunks from 6 6 categories using a masked attention mechanism similar to ours.
These systems are efficient but target fixed policy spaces rather than outputting per-criterion verdicts for open-ended natural-language criteria.
blocks.zh:
一些有效的核查人员对在培训时基本确定的小型规则集进行培训。
诸如Llama Guard [22],ShieldGemma [66],WildGuard [18],以及Qune3Guard [70] 等安全卫士通过短标签生成或分类头,对预先定义的6 6– 14 个伤害类别作出安全判断.
Llama Guard允许通过即时进行定制分类,但分类仍是一个简短的列举列表,而不是开放式的自然语言标准.
宪法分类[52,9]使用自然语言宪法生成合成培训数据,并按固定宪法培训一个分类器.
ArmoRM[58]等多目标奖励模型同样具有固定的维度.
在视频领域,Safe Watch [7] 使用类似于我们的蒙面关注机制,从6个类别编码了安全政策块。
这些系统是高效率的,但针对的是固定的政策空间,而不是按标准对开放的自然语言标准作出裁定。

blocks.en:
A second family conditions on natural-language inputs at inference time, emitting verdicts via prompted generation or learned scoring.
This includes generative judge frameworks [ 72 , 28 , 75 , 19 , 8 ] , context-conditioned reward models [ 65 , 59 , 17 , 21 , 15 , 38 , 55 , 48 , 42 ] , and policy-conditioned guards such as gpt-oss-safeguard [ 46 ] , Granite Guardian [ 47 ] , PolicyGuard [ 61 ] , NeMo Guardrails [ 50 ] , and DynaGuard [ 20 ] .
These approaches adapt to natural-language inputs at inference time, but face a tradeoff between scalability and per-criterion attribution. Methods that emit an aggregate verdict can be fast; for example, DynaGuard-4B reports 11.6 11.6 ms per DynaBench example ( ∼ 1,318 {\sim}1{,}318 input tokens, 1 1 output token) [ 20 ] . But exposing per-criterion verdicts requires either a separate call per criterion or autoregressive output whose length grows with N N .
blocks.zh:
家庭在推论时对自然语言投入的第二个条件,通过激励一代人或学到的分数作出判断。
这包括基因裁判框架[72,28,75,19,8],上下文条件的奖励模式[65,59,17,21,15,38,55,48,42],以及有政策条件的警卫,如gpt-oss-seguard[46],Granite Guardian[47],PoliticGuard[61],NeMo Guardrails[50],和DynaGuard[20].
这些方法在推论时适应自然语言的投入,但面对可伸缩性和每个标准归属之间的权衡. 发出汇总判决的方法可以是快速的;例如,DynaGuard-4B报告每个Dyna Bench例11.6 11.6 ms(~1,318 {\sim}1{,}318个输入符,1个输出符)[20]. 但是,公布每个标准的判决,需要按标准单独调用,或自动递减输出,其长度随NN增长。

blocks.en: Outcome and process reward models for mathematical reasoning [ 36 , 68 ] operate on a single fixed correctness criterion within their domain. The VFM accepts a broader range of natural-language criteria, capturing both safety/guardrail-style judgments and correctness checks.
blocks.zh: 数学推理的结果和过程奖励模型[36,68]在其域内以单一的固定正确性标准运作. VFM接受更广泛的自然语言标准,既包括安全/护栏式判断,也包括正确性检查。

blocks.en: Formal verification methods, originally developed for monitoring system traces against properties specified in formal languages [ 4 , 34 ] , have recently been extended to LLM-based agents [ 1 , 63 ] . In particular, TRAC [ 1 ] combines learned labeling of atomic propositions over natural-language interactions with symbolic LTL progression to monitor temporally extended requirements. The VFM could instantiate TRAC’s labeling function by efficiently evaluating multiple natural-language predicates at each interaction step.
blocks.zh: 正式核查方法最初是针对正式语言[4、34]规定的属性为监测系统追踪而开发的,最近已扩大到基于LLM的代理人[1、63]。 特别是,TRAC [1]将关于自然语言相互作用的原子命题的学得标签与象征性的LTL进化结合起来,以监测时间上的延伸要求。 VFM可以通过在每个互动步骤上有效评价多种自然语言的上游,从而即时发挥TRAC的标签功能。

blocks.en: Recent systems move closer to open-ended rule conditioning. LMUnit [ 51 ] scores arbitrary natural-language unit tests, while RLBFF [ 59 ] , SafePyramid [ 67 ] , and SingGuard [ 53 ] condition evaluation on natural-language principles or policies. These systems strengthen the case for runtime policy conditioning. Concurrently with our work, SingGuard also evaluates rules in parallel, using a shared-prefix rule-isolation mask with branch-local position IDs; its fast path emits binary hit/not-hit outputs, whereas the VFM reads out ternary verdicts from a classification head. We compare with LMUnit in Section C.5 .
blocks.zh: 最近的系统更接近于开放式规则条件. LMUnit [51] 评分任意自然语言单元测试,而RLBFF [59],SafePyramid [67],和SingGuard [53] 对自然语言原理或政策的条件评价. 这些系统加强了对运行时间政策条件的看法。 与我们的工作同时,SingGuard还同时评价规则,使用带有分支-局部位置ID的共享前缀规则隔离掩码;其快速路径发出二进制命中/非命中输出,而VFM则从一个分类头读出三角判断. 我们比较C.5节的LM股。

blocks.en: The rule-conditional reward model of DeepMind’s Sparrow [ 14 ] is a particularly close early predecessor. While trained on only 23 hand-coded rules without demonstrated generalization beyond them, Sparrow conditions on each rule as free text, shares prefix computation across rule queries to scale sublinearly with rule count, and issues per-rule violation probabilities.
blocks.zh: DeepMind's Sparrow [14] 的规则-条件奖励模式是特别近的早期前身. 虽然只训练了23个手编码规则而没有显示超出其范围的一般化,但Sparrow在每项规则上的条件作为自由文本,在规则查询中共享前缀计算,以按照规则计数进行子线性分级,并发布每个规则的违反概率.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
The VFM maps a context x x (system prompt, history, tool calls, etc.), target text t t (a response or action), and set of natural language criteria { c i } i = 1 N \{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , to a set of per-criterion probabilities: ( x , t , { c i } i = 1 N ) ↦ { p i yes , p i no , p i n/a } i = 1 N . (x,\,t,\,\{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N})\mapsto\{\,p_{i}^{\textsc{yes}},\;p_{i}^{\textsc{no}},\;p_{i}^{\textsc{n/a}}\,\}_{i=1}^{N}. Each criterion is an atomic yes/no question about a verifiable property of the (context, target) pair. Although the VFM can nominally accept any natural language criteria, we focus on criteria that are specific enough that a human auditor could give a verdict from the trace alone. “Does the response cite the regulation it is applying?” is verifiable, but “Does this response comply with all relevant SEC regulations?” is not. The latter type should first be decomposed into more specific criteria. Section A.1 formalizes the criteria schema and its exclusions, which we apply during CriteriaBank generation ( Section 3.2 ).
The ternary label set follows an established pattern in natural language verification [ 57 , 29 , 37 ] , with n/a covering two distinct cases. First, a criterion may be inapplicable because its precondition is not met (e.g., no regulation is being applied). Second, it may be applicable but unanswerable from the trace (e.g., the response cites a regulation, but it is unclear which regulation is applied). We collapse both cases into a single n/a label. The two cases can call for different monitoring actions, however: an inapplicable rule can be ignored, while an undeterminable one may warrant escalation. Explicit preconditions could be checked as separate criteria to tell the cases apart ( Section A.1 ).
3.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑

blocks.en: The VFM encodes the shared (context, target) prefix and all N N criterion branches in a single sequence, using a tree attention mask to enforce per-criterion isolation. This independent readout layout, where appended tokens attend to a shared prefix but not to each other, has been used for parallel decoding in speculative inference [ 41 , 6 ] , batched query processing [ 27 ] , tree-structured inference [ 64 ] , and action readout in robotics [ 44 ] . Functionally, it is equivalent to computing the shared prefix’s key-value cache once and reusing it for every criterion. We apply it to criterion-conditioned verification, replacing the language-model head with a 3-class classification head and pairing it with branching position IDs to obtain per-criterion independence and permutation invariance as structural guarantees.

blocks.en: 3.2 CriteriaBank Pretraining Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.2 标准银行

blocks.en: Table 2: CriteriaBank composition by data stream.
blocks.zh: 表2:按数据流分列的标准银行构成。

blocks.en:
CriteriaBank is a training corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning 321K distinct criterion strings, each labeled in { yes , no , n/a } \{\textsc{yes},\textsc{no},\textsc{n/a}\} . It is constructed from five complementary data streams ( Table 2 ), designed to cover criterion-conditioned verification across heterogeneous settings.
Stream A aims for broad criteria coverage through concept-first synthesis, generating labeled examples for each LLM-brainstormed criterion across diverse conversational scenarios; n/a examples are constructed via mix-and-match pairing and counterfactual augmentation.
Stream B, the core of the dataset ( ∼ 62 % {\sim}62\% of tuples), uses a teacher model to brainstorm context-appropriate criteria for ∼ 50 {\sim}50 K real conversations sampled from WildChat [ 71 ] and WildJailbreak [ 24 ] using Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B as the teacher. Generated samples then undergo semantic deduplication to remove near-duplicate criteria.
Streams C and D add targeted coverage of underrepresented domains and safety scenarios, respectively, and Stream C+ extends the same pipeline to multi-turn conversations sampled from LMSYS-Chat-1M [ 73 ] . See Appendix B for full CriteriaBank details.
A fixed-budget leave-one-out ablation probes the contribution of Streams A, C, and D, while a separate full-corpus comparison finds that removing Stream B reduces performance by 11.5 11.5 pp on PRM800K, 5.3 5.3 pp on IFEval, and 4.1 4.1 pp on Governance ( Section B.2 ).

一笔固定预算的一劳永逸地计算出A流、C流和D流的贡献,而一笔单独的全公司比较发现,删除B流使业绩减少11.5页PRM800K、5.3页IFEval和4.1页(B.2节)。

blocks.en: All CriteriaBank labels are model-generated. We use two independent judges from different model families, with disagreements adjudicated by a third model. In a 75-item blind co-author audit, these labels agree with the human majority on 88.4 % 88.4\% of the 69 scorable items ( 95.8 % 95.8\% where all three annotators agree), compared with 73.9 % 73.9\% for the labels Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B assigned at generation. See Sections B.1 and C.8 for the labeling process and audit protocol.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训

blocks.en: We attach a linear three-class classification head to Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-0.6B [ 62 ] , and score binary benchmarks by thresholding the yes probability at a dev-selected threshold. The head is initialized from the rows of the base model’s unembedding matrix corresponding to the verbalizer tokens Yes , No , and Unknown , so that before any training the head reproduces the backbone’s zero-shot verbalizer logits. This warm start removes the need for a separate frozen-backbone head-training phase. CriteriaBank pretraining is end-to-end with full parameter updates at an effective batch size of 128. Downstream finetuning runs for up to 30 epochs with early stopping against a fixed 300-example dev set (patience 5 epochs), with dev-selected checkpoints. See Section B.3 for the full training recipe and Appendix C for benchmark adaptation details.
blocks.zh: 我们附加了一个线性三等分类头到Qune3-4B和Qune3-0.6B[62],并通过在dev-select阈值上将"是"概率阈值的阈值进行阈值,得出二进制基准. 头部从基模的未嵌入矩阵的行中初始化,对应语言符号 在训练前, 头部会复制骨干零镜头的口音记录。 这种温暖的开始消除了单独冷冻后骨头训练阶段的需要. 标准Bank预训是端到端,以128的有效批量大小进行完整的参数更新. 下游微调运行长达30个纪元,对固定300个实例的dev集(patience 5 epocs)进行早期停放,并设有dev选用的检查站. 完整的培训方法见B.3节,基准适应细节见附录C。

blocks.en: We found that fitting CriteriaBank too closely can reduce downstream adaptability, much like plasticity loss in continual learning [ 10 ] . We therefore add a token-level KL penalty to the CriteriaBank pretraining loss, anchoring the backbone’s next-token distribution to the base model. Throughout the paper, VFM denotes this KL-regularized model and VFM (w/o KL) the unregularized ablation. Section B.3 gives the full objective and training details.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,适合标准银行太近可以降低下游的适应性,就像在不断学习中失去可塑性[10]。 因此,我们在标准银行的预训损失中增加了象征性的KL级处罚,将骨干下部的分布固定在基准模型上。 在整个论文中,VFM表示这种KL规范化的模型,VFM(w/o KL)表示非规范化的衰减. B.3节提供了全部目标和培训细节。

( Section 4.5 )

blocks.en: 4.1 Synthetic Governance
blocks.zh: 4.1 合成治理

blocks.en: In the absence of a suitable benchmark with regulatory criteria, we synthesize a governance dataset with 52 criteria sourced from five regulations, which we divide into two parts: 32 in-distribution criteria spanning EU AI Act Article 50 (9), GDPR Article 13 (14), and SEC Regulation Best Interest (9), plus 20 held-out transfer criteria covering HIPAA Privacy Rule §164.520 (11) and PCI-DSS v4.0 (9). The dataset contains a total of 130 in-distribution training interactions, 20 in-distribution dev interactions, 60 in-distribution test interactions, and 40 out-of-distribution test interactions. Checkpoint selection uses only the in-distribution dev set. See Section C.6 for dataset details.
blocks.zh: 由于没有适当的基准和监管标准,我们综合了一个治理数据集,其中52项标准来自5项条例,我们将其分为两部分:32项分配标准,涵盖欧盟《大赦国际法》第50(9)条、GDPR第13(14)条和证监会《监管最佳利益》(9),加上20项搁置转移标准,涵盖HIPAA隐私规则§164.520(11)和PCI-DSS v4.0(9)。 该数据集共包含130个分布式培训互动,20个分布式dev互动,60个分布式测试互动,40个分布式测试互动. 检查点选择只使用分布式dev集. 数据集详情见C.6节。

blocks.en: Governance interactions and their corresponding labels were drafted together by Claude Sonnet 4.6, and audited by Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro. To probe residual label noise, a panel of three co-author annotators (blind to the benchmark labels) independently labeled 75 items. Under the binary satisfied-vs-not-satisfied projection ( yes vs. non- yes ), human–label pairwise agreement was 87–92% ( κ = 0.69 \kappa=0.69 – 0.82 0.82 ). Ternary agreement was lower, since annotators lacked the regulatory trigger conditions, and frequently applied n/a where the benchmark label was no . A second round supplying those trigger conditions inline resolved most disagreements, leaving 5 unanimous and 4 plurality label-human disagreements out of 75 ( Section C.7 ).
blocks.zh: 治理互动及其相应的标签由克劳德·索内4.6共同起草,由克劳德·奥普斯4.6和双子座3.1 Pro审计. 为了探测残余标签噪声,由三位共同作者的注释者组成的一个面板(对基准标签视而不见)独立地标注了75项. 在二进制满足-vs-不满意的投影(是对非是)下,人-标签对偶协议为87–92 % ( = 0.69\kappa= 0.69– 0.82 0.82 ) 。 第三方协议较低,因为注释者缺乏监管触发条件,并且经常在基准标签没有的情况下适用n/a。 第二轮谈判提供了这些触发条件,解决了大多数分歧,在75个分歧中,有5个是一致的,4个是多元的,是人类的(C.7节)。

blocks.en: After finetuning on 2,247 training examples with criteria from the three in-distribution regulations (EU AI Act, GDPR, SEC Reg BI), VFM-4B reaches 88.8% accuracy on the held-out test set, outperforming non-finetuned baselines including GPT-5.4 ( Table 4 ). In-distribution accuracy is close across the three finetuned variants. On the held-out transfer domains (healthcare and payment processing, which add HIPAA and PCI-DSS criteria), where dev-selection is performed in-distribution only, VFM transfers best at both scales, by margins comparable to seed variation ( Section C.6 ).
blocks.zh: 在对2,247个培训实例进行精细调整后,采用了三项分配条例(欧盟AI法、GDPR、SEC Reg BI)的标准,VFM-4B在停产测试中达到了88.8%的准确度,超过了包括GPT-5.4在内的绩效不纯基线(表4)。 分布精度接近于三个微调的变体. 关于搁置的转让领域(保健和付款处理,其中增加了HIPAA和PCI-DSS标准),只进行非选择性分配,VFM在两种规模下的最佳转让,其幅度可与种子变化相当(C.6节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 INSURE-Dial
blocks.zh: 4.2 INSURE-数字

blocks.en: INSURE-Dial [ 30 ] provides 50 real insurance-benefit verification calls, yielding 417 test criteria instantiated from 9 atomic-criterion templates. We finetune on 2K synthetic records from its training split and, because synthetic dev accuracy saturates early, select checkpoints by 5-fold cross-validation over the real calls. Finetuning is essential on this benchmark. Without it, the unregularized VFM never predicts n/a , a size-matched Qwen3-4B judge almost never does, and both score near the 47.5 % 47.5\% obtained by always answering yes ( Table 4 ). After finetuning, every variant beats GPT-5.4 queried per criterion, but CriteriaBank pretraining does not help, and Direct-FT leads at both scales (within noise at 4B). False passes remain the main weakness: the finetuned 4B models label 19 19 – 26 % 26\% of gold violations as satisfied, usually with high confidence. See Section C.9 for details.
blocks.zh: INSURE-Dial [30]提供50个真实的保险-福利核查呼叫,从9个原子-标准模板中即时生成417个测试标准. 我们从训练中微调2K合成记录, 并且由于合成精度提前饱和, 对这一基准进行微调至关重要。 没有它,没有正规化的VFM从未预测n/a,一个大小匹配的Quen3-4B评委几乎从未预测过,两者的得分都接近总回答是的47.5%47.5\%(表4). 经过微调后,每个变体都会比GPT-5.4对每个标准进行询问,但标准银行预训无济于事,直接FT在两个尺度(在4B的噪声内)都领先. 假证仍然是主要弱点:4B型标注在19 19 — — 26 % 的 26 — — 的金币违规情况很满意,通常是高度自信。 详情见C.9节。

blocks.en: 4.3 DynaBench Guardrail Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.3 Dyna Bench警卫铁路基准

blocks.en: DynaBench [ 20 ] consists of 543 held-out multi-turn dialogues, each paired with ∼ 14 {\sim}14 free-text rules (max 92 92 ). A trace evaluates to FAIL if any rule is violated. We finetune VFM-4B on 75,031 75{,}031 (trace, criterion) training pairs spanning 13,997 13{,}997 unique traces for a fixed budget of 400 steps (batch size 128), keeping the checkpoint with the highest dev-set F1. We apply a one-time, label-blind GPT-5.4 pipeline that translates each declarative rule into one or more VFM-compatible atomic questions, which produces 1.52 1.52 questions per rule on average. Both VFM and the Gemma judge are evaluated using these translated rules, and we additionally evaluate the judge with raw rules ( Section C.10 ).
blocks.zh: Dyna Bench [20] 由543个被搁置的多回合对话组成,每个对话与 \\ 14 \ sim}14 自由文本规则(最大 92 92 )对齐. 如果违反任何规则,则跟踪评估FAIL。 我们调整了75 031 75{,} 031(追踪,标准)训练对,跨越13 997 13{,}997个独特的痕迹,用于400步的固定预算(批量尺寸128),使检查站保持最高的dev-set F1. 我们采用一次性的,标签盲式的GPT-5.4管道,将每个声明规则转化为一个或多个与VFM兼容的原子问题,平均每条规则产生1.52.1.52个问题. 对VFM和Gemma法官都使用这些翻译规则进行评价,我们还用原始规则评价法官(C.10节)。

blocks.en: Unlike the baselines, VFM-4B issues per-criterion verdicts for all rules, and we label the trace as FAIL if any verdict resolves to FAIL. It reaches 0.885 0.885 F1, outperforming both DynaGuard variants and the similarly sized Gemma 4 E4B. The larger 26B Gemma 4 reaches 0.922 0.922 F1 when given all rules, while a cascade that gives it the VFM’s top-3 most likely violated rules reaches 0.946 0.946 . The VFM ranks the violated rule first on 97.6 % 97.6\% of failing traces and within the top-3 on all of them. See Section C.11 for precision, recall, and false-pass rates, and Section C.10 for further localization and escalation analyses.
blocks.zh: 与基线不同的是,VFM-4B针对所有规则发布每个标准的判决,如果任何判决解决到FAIL,我们就将追踪标记为FAIL. 它达到0.885 0.885 F1,优于DynaGuard变体和类似大小的Gemma 4 E4B. 更大的26B Gemma 4在给定所有规则时达到0.922 0.922 F1,而让VFM的顶级-3最有可能违反规则的级联则达到0.946 0.946. VFM将违反的规则排在97.6%的97.6+%的失败痕迹上,并在所有这些痕迹中排在前3位。 准确性、召回率和假通行证率见C.11节,进一步本地化和升级分析见C.10节。

blocks.en: 4.4 Cross-Domain Verification and Sample Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 跨领域核查和抽样效率

blocks.en: To test whether the VFM can be used for verification in diverse settings, we evaluate on five benchmarks spanning safety, instruction following, mathematical reasoning, grounded claim support, and legal NLI. Each benchmark’s criteria are reformulated as natural language verification questions ( Appendix C ). The finetuned 4B verifiers beat a linear probe and a size-matched Qwen3-4B judge on every benchmark, and beat the larger Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B chain-of-thought judge on BeaverTails, IFEval, and ContractNLI ( Table 13 ). The 80B judge is stronger on PRM800K and LLM-AggreFact, but decodes a reasoning chain for every verdict. On LLM-AggreFact, the finetuning data come from other fact-verification corpora, and additional finetuning data eventually lower accuracy for all three variants ( Fig. 2 ), consistent with distribution shift. Full-data performance is close across the three finetuned variants, and the benefit of CriteriaBank pretraining appears mainly at low data.
blocks.zh: 为了检验VFM是否可用于不同环境下的核查,我们评估了涵盖安全、遵循指示、数学推理、基于权利主张的支持和合法的NLI等五个基准。 每个基准的标准被重新定为自然语言核查问题(附录C)。 微调的4B验证器在每一个基准上击败一个线性探测器和一个大小匹配的Qwen3-4B判断器,并在BeaverTails, IFEval,和ContractNLI(表13)上击败了更大的Quen3-Next-80B-A3B链思判器. 80B法官在PRM800K和LLM-AggreFact上更为强大,但解码每个判决的推理链. 在LLM-AggreFact上,微调数据来自其他事实验证的corpora,额外的微调数据最终会降低所有三种变体的精度(图2),与分布偏移一致. 完整的数据性能在三个微调变体之间很接近,标准银行预训的好处主要出现在低数据中.

blocks.en: We measure adaptation efficiency with 0.6B learning curves from n = 100 n{=}100 to the full training set ( Fig. 2 ). Both pretrained variants lead at the smallest budgets, but the unregularized model gives much of this advantage back as n n grows. The KL-regularized VFM has the best area under the learning curve on all six benchmarks (macro AULC 0.789 0.789 , vs. 0.772 0.772 without KL and 0.736 0.736 for Direct-FT). CriteriaBank pretraining also supplies most of the zero-shot ordering ability ( Section C.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用0.6B的学习曲线测量适应效率,从n = 100 n = o = 100 到完整的训练集(图2 )。 两种经过预先训练的变体在最小的预算上领先,但非正规化的模型随着nn的生长而赋予了大部分这种优势. KL正规化的VFM在所有六个基准(宏 AULC 0.789 0.789,无KL的为0.772 0.772,直接-FT为0.736 0.736)的学习曲线下拥有最好的领域. 标准银行的预训也提供大部分零射定购能力(C.5节)。

blocks.en: 4.5 Latency
blocks.zh: 4.5 延迟

blocks.en: We measure verification latency on a single H100 (80 GB, bf16), sweeping the number of criteria N N at three prefix lengths (context + target text). We benchmark three variants on identical HuggingFace Transformers infrastructure, with the prefix KV computed once and cached: vfm-pc (the tree-mask layout of Section 3.1 , with criteria processed in chunks of size c c over the shared prefix), vfm-batched (prefix replicated per row, all N N in one forward pass), and llm-prefix (a size-matched Qwen3 LLM-judge with the prefix KV cached via DynamicCache ). Table 6 reports the best VFM variant per regime alongside the llm-prefix baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个H100(80GB,bf16)来测量核查的延迟性,用三个前缀长度(context +目标文本)来扫描标准N N的数量. 我们以相同的HuggingFace变形器基础设施为基准,将前缀KV计算一次并缓存:vfm-pc(第3.1节的树框布局,在大小的块中处理c比共享前缀多的标准),vfm-battled(每行复制前缀,前缀N全部为前缀)和lm-prefix(通过DynamicCach处理前缀KV缓存). 表6报告每个系统的最佳VFM变体与lm前缀基线并列。

blocks.en: The VFM’s advantage grows with prefix length and N N , and at ∼ 4 {\sim}4 K tokens it is faster in every cell. vfm-pc holds peak VRAM under 11 11 GB regardless of N N . VFM-4B verifies N = 1,000 N{=}1{,}000 criteria at a ∼ 4 {\sim}4 K-token prefix in 1.81 1.81 s, well within an LLM-decoding turn ( 2 2 – 20 20 s at 50 50 – 100 100 tokens/s) [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: VFM的优势随着前缀长度和N N 的增大而增长,在QQ 4 → sim}4 K 的令牌上,每个单元格都更快. vfm-pc在11 11 GB下持有峰值VRAM,无论NN. VFM-4B 验证 N = 1000 N{=}1{,} 000 个标准在 1.81 1.81 s 的 ∼ 4 K-token 前缀, 远在 LLM-解码转弯( 2 2 – 20 20 s at 50 – 100 orders/s) [31].

blocks.en: Tree attention implements a general pattern: encode the shared context once and evaluate each criterion as an isolated branch. vLLM’s automatic prefix caching [ 31 ] implements the same pattern, under which one-token readouts of the VFM backbone and the base model match in latency, while generative judges remain slower ( Section C.3 ). The VFM pairs this pattern with CriteriaBank-trained weights and a ternary head, and runs in under 11 GB without a serving stack.
blocks.zh: 树注意执行一般模式:将共享上下文编码一次,并将每个标准评价为孤立分支. vLLM的自动前缀缓存 [31] 执行相同的模式,在这种模式下,一键读取VFM主干线和基模型在纬度上的匹配,而基因判断仍然较慢(C.3节). VFM将这种模式与标准Bank训练的重量和一个三角头对齐,运行在11GB以下,没有服务堆栈.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: AI deployers lack a scalable runtime monitoring layer for the natural language obligations that training-time alignment and prompting alone cannot reliably ensure. With a view to closing this gap, we introduced the VFM, a tree-attention-based verifier that issues ternary per-criterion verdicts on a set of natural language criteria specified at runtime. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a 394K-tuple corpus that improves low-data transfer. CriteriaBank pretraining alone remains insufficiently broad and too poorly calibrated for strong zero-shot verification. Future work should improve the quality and diversity of CriteriaBank, develop cascaded escalation protocols, connect these verdicts to formal monitoring systems such as TRAC [ 1 ] , and automate the decomposition of complex specifications into criteria.
blocks.zh: 人工智能部署人员缺乏可扩展的运行时间监测层,无法可靠地确保培训时间的调整和推动的自然语言义务。 为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了VFM,这是一个基于树心的核查器,根据运行时规定的一套自然语言标准,对每条标准作出三重判决。 VFM在标准银行(StandardBank)上进行了预先训练,这是394K-全元体,可以改善低数据传输. 光是银行的预训仍然不够广泛,而且校准也太差,无法进行强有力的零射核查。 今后的工作应提高标准银行的质量和多样性,制定连锁升级协议,将这些判决与TRAC[1]等正式监测系统联系起来,并将复杂规格的分解自动化为标准。

blocks.en: Performance is not yet sufficient for reliable governance. On real insurance-benefit calls, even the best finetuned verifier approves approximately 20 % 20\% of gold violations, mostly with high confidence, so that confidence-based escalation recovers few of them ( Section C.9 ). CriteriaBank labels are model-generated, and their errors carry over to the VFM ( Section C.8 ). The governance benchmark is synthetic, and our human validation is limited to 75-item co-author audits rather than an independent study on real compliance data. CriteriaBank targets positively phrased atomic criteria, and the VFM does not model inter-criterion dependencies. Robustness to adaptive attacks, such as agents optimized against the verifier, remains untested. Our evaluations are English-only and text-only, and we have not checked them for overlap with backbone or judge pretraining data. VFM-style verification is therefore best suited to monitoring and escalation rather than standalone enforcement.
blocks.zh: 业绩尚不足以进行可靠的治理。 在实际的保险福利呼吁中,即使是最精细的核查者也批准约20%的20%的黄金违规,大部分情况下具有高度的信心,因此,基于信任的升级使其中很少人恢复(C.9节)。 标准银行的标签是模型生成的,其错误会结转到VFM(C.8节). 治理基准是合成的,我们的人的验证仅限于75项共同作者审计,而不是对真实合规数据的独立研究. 标准Bank针对正面的短语原子标准,VFM不建模标准间依赖性. 对适应性攻击的强性,如对核查者进行优化的物剂,仍然没有经过测试. 我们的评价只有英文和文本,我们没有检查这些评价与主干数据或法官预训数据的重叠。 因此,VFM式的核查最适合监测和升级,而不是单独执行。

blocks.en: Appendix A Method Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 方法细节

blocks.en: A.1 Verifiable Concept Schema
blocks.zh: A.1 可验证的概念Schema

blocks.en: Each criterion is intended to be an instance of a verifiable concept : an atomic yes/no question about a (context, target text) pair, answerable as YES, NO, or N/A by an informed auditor. CriteriaBank distinguishes two types of atomic concepts.
blocks.zh: 每项标准都旨在成为可核查概念的一个实例:一对(文字、目标文本)的原子是/否问题,由知情审计员回答为是、否或否。 标准Bank区分了两类原子概念.

blocks.en: These are questions about the conversation history x x alone, without reference to the target text, and can serve as preconditions for property concepts, e.g., “Based on the conversation history, is it reasonable to conclude that the user is under 13?” A context concept evaluates to YES if the history provides sufficient evidence, NO if it provides contrary evidence, and N/A if the history is silent.
blocks.zh: 这些都是关于对话历史xxx的问题,没有提及目标文本,可以作为财产概念的前提条件,例如,“根据对话历史,得出用户低于13岁的结论是否合理?” 一个上下文概念评价为是,如果历史提供了足够的证据,如果它提供了相反的证据,则不;如果历史沉默,则不作评价。

blocks.en: These are questions about the target text t t given the context, e.g., “Does the text contain commercial advertising directed at a child?” When an explicit or implicit precondition of a property concept evaluates to NO or N/A, the property concept is inapplicable and its label should be N/A. This is the mechanism by which CriteriaBank distinguishes “the property is absent” ( no ) from “the property was not required” ( n/a ), although downstream applications of the VFM might have different NO-N/A semantics.
blocks.zh: 鉴于上下文,这些都是关于目标文本t t的问题,例如,“案文是否载有针对儿童的商业广告?” 当财产概念的明示或默示先决条件对NO或N/A进行评价时,财产概念不适用,其标签应为N/A。 这是标准银行将“财产不存在”(无)与“财产不需要”(不适用)区分的机制,尽管VFM的下游应用可能有不同的NO-N/A语义。

blocks.en: Within CriteriaBank, the criteria are assumed to be atomic (one verifiable property per question) and positively phrased (YES = criterion satisfied). Questions requiring external world knowledge not present in the context, purely subjective judgments, or outcomes observable only over long time horizons are out of scope. Downstream applications with negatively phrased criteria, criteria that rely on external knowledge, or different N/A semantics require task-specific finetuning.
blocks.zh: 在标准银行内,假定标准是原子(每个问题一个可核查的属性)和正面措辞(YES=满足的标准)。 需要外部世界知识的问题,在上下文中没有,纯粹主观的判断,或只在很长的时间内才能观察到的结果,都是超出范围的问题。 下游应用带有负面的短语标准,依赖外部知识的标准,或者不同的N/A语义需要针对特定任务的微调.

blocks.en: We classified n/a labels by tracing how each benchmark assigns them. Governance labels are derived deterministically from the drafted compliance flags ( Section C.6 ), and n/a arises only when an interaction falls outside a criterion’s applicability domain or a conditional criterion’s precondition does not hold, so all 304 n/a labels in its 920-record test set are inapplicability cases. INSURE-Dial assigns n/a when the call did not require the protocol step a criterion checks, so its 140 n/a labels (of 417) are also inapplicability cases. ContractNLI’s NotMentioned class marks hypotheses the contract does not address, so all 903 of its n/a labels are evidence-insufficient.

blocks.en: B.1 CriteriaBank: Stream Construction
blocks.zh: B.1 标准库:流建

blocks.en: Stream A is a concept-first synthetic stream designed for broad criteria coverage. We begin with 2,625 2{,}625 distinct criterion strings generated by prompting GPT-5.1 to brainstorm structured (Context, Property) concepts according to the schema in Section A.1 . For each criterion, the Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B generator produces ten labeled examples—five YES and five NO—distributed across a fixed inventory of conversational scenarios (single-turn simple, single-turn detailed, multi-turn clarification, iterative refinement, follow-up, with-code-context, expert-vs-novice). To produce n/a -labeled examples, we use two complementary methods: mix-and-match pairs an example synthesized for criterion A A with a different criterion B B whose precondition does not hold, and counterfactual augmentation rewrites the conversation history to remove a criterion’s precondition. The generator targets a balanced label mix, but the judge panel (below) labels most of the stream’s n/a candidates no , and a small number of rows are dropped during labeling.
blocks.zh: 流线 A是一种概念第一合成流,旨在涵盖广泛的标准。 我们从2,625,2{,}625个不同的标准字符串开始,通过促使GPT-5.1按照A.1节中的计划来集思广益结构化(Context,Property)概念. 对于每一项标准,Quen3-Next-80B-A3B生成器产生10个标注的例子——5个是和5个NO——分布在固定的谈话情景清单中(单转简单,单转详细,多转澄清,迭代完善,后续,带码文本,专家-vs-革新). 要生成n/a-标签的示例,我们使用两种互补方法:混合和匹配对一例,为标准A合成,而标准B的前提条件不同;反事实增强重写对话历史,以删除标准的先决条件。 生成器瞄准一个平衡的标签组合,但评委面板(以下)标注了溪流的大多数n/a候选人没有,在标注时少部分行被丢弃.

blocks.en: Stream B grounds training in real conversations. We reservoir-sample 50K conversations from WildChat [ 71 ] (90%) and WildJailbreak [ 24 ] (10%), applying minimal quality filters (English, minimum length, character-class thresholds). For each conversation we cut at a single random assistant turn and use Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B to brainstorm nine verifiable criteria (three YES, three NO, three n/a ). We then embed each criterion using google/embeddinggemma-300m , cluster per-label with FAISS greedy clustering at cosine threshold 0.85 0.85 , and cap each cluster at 50 50 examples (smaller clusters are retained in full).
blocks.zh: 在真正的对话中进行B流训练。 我们从 WildChat [71] (90%) 和 WildJailbreak [24] (10%) 进行水库-样本 50K 的对话,应用最低质量过滤器(英语,最小长度,字符级阈值). 每一次谈话,我们在一个单随机助手转弯时切开,并使用Qune3-Next-80B-A3B来集思广益九个可核查的标准(三个是,三个NO,三个n/a). 然后我们使用google/embeddinggemma-300m 将每个标准嵌入,每条标签与FAISS贪婪的集群在余弦阈值0.85 0.85 处,每个集群封顶50例(较小型的集群保留完整).

blocks.en: WildChat underrepresents tool use, error correction, long-document tasks, business processes, and requests with several interacting requirements. Stream C targets these five gap categories with 30 scenarios (e.g., a failed tool call, a user correcting a factual error, contract review, an escalation workflow), each crossed with 18 domains and three difficulty levels. GPT-5.1 writes three short scenario seeds for each of the 1,620 combinations, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B expands each seed into a full conversation (4,860 in total), and the Stream B pipeline then generates and deduplicates nine criteria per conversation.
blocks.zh: WildChat underpresents 工具使用,错误校正,长文档任务,业务流程,以及具有多个交互要求的请求. 流线 C针对这五个缺口类别,有30种情景(例如,一个失败的工具调用,一个用户纠正一个事实错误,合同审查,一个升级的工作流程),每个选项有18个域和三个难度级. GPT-5.1为1,620个组合中每个组合写了3个短的场景种子,Qune3-Next-80B-A3B将每个种子扩展成一个完整的对话(共4,860个),流B输油管随后生成并简化了每次对话的9个标准.

blocks.en: Streams A–D are dominated by exchanges with few turns, whereas deployed agents are increasingly evaluated over many-turn interactions. Stream C+ applies the Stream B pipeline (same Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B criterion generator, same deduplication) to English conversations with at least five turns reservoir-sampled from LMSYS-Chat-1M [ 73 ] . Because the LMSYS-Chat-1M license does not permit redistributing its conversations, we release Stream C+ as conversation identifiers and turn indices, together with a script that rebuilds each tuple from the licensed source.
blocks.zh: A至D流以交流为主,转弯很少,而部署的代理人则越来越多地接受对多转弯相互作用的评价。 Stream C+将Stream B输油管(相同的Qune3-Next-80B-A3B标准生成器,同样的减速)应用于英语对话中,至少从LMSYS-Chat-1M中抽取5个转向库样本. [73]. 由于LMSYS-Chat-1M许可证不允许重新分配其对话,我们释放Stream C+作为对话识别符,并转动索引,以及一个脚本,从许可来源重建每块拖累.

blocks.en: Stream D extends Stream A’s concept-first pipeline to a curated safety taxonomy of 45 45 harm categories (e.g., violence_physical , hate_speech , self_harm_suicide , child_sexual_abuse ) drawn from academic safety benchmarks (BeaverTails, ToxiGen, HarmBench) and industry policy taxonomies. A backbone generator brainstorms ∼ 50 {\sim}50 atomic safety criteria per category, validated for schema compliance (e.g., positive phrasing, Section A.1 ), which produces 2,204 2{,}204 safety criteria with concept IDs of the form property.safety.<category>.<idx> . The same generator produces labeled YES/NO examples per criterion. Stream D contains no n/a examples by design, since each example is constructed to be applicable to its criterion. The criteria target harm categories that Streams B and C cover only incidentally.
blocks.zh: 流 D 扩展 Stream A的概念第一管道是45个危害类别(如暴力、身体、仇恨、自我伤害、儿童性、虐待)的分类, 骨干发电机脑暴 → 50 ~ sim} 50 原子安全标准每类,经验证符合计划(如正字法,A.1节),生成2,204 2{,}204 安全标准,并附有形式属性的概念标识. 安全。“分类”.“idx”。 同一生成器每个标准产生标注为是/否的例子。 串流D没有按设计列出n/a的例子,因为每个例子的构造都是为了适用于其标准。 标准针对的是B组和C组仅偶然涵盖的伤害类别。

blocks.en: Each generated example carries a candidate label from its generator. Final labels are assigned by two judges from different model families, Gemma-4-26B-A4B and Qwen3.6-27B, which label each example independently using a prompt that distinguishes a committed no (the property is absent) from n/a (the criterion does not apply or cannot be decided). When the judges agree, their label is final. When they disagree, a third model (DeepSeek-V4) labels the example under the same prompt without seeing their verdicts, and the majority of the three labels is final, with DeepSeek-V4’s label used if all three differ. Section C.8 compares both the candidate labels and the final labels with human annotation.
blocks.zh: 每个生成的例子都带有其生成器的候选标签. 最终的标签由来自不同模范家族的两名法官Gemma-4-26B-A4B和Quen3.6-27B指定,他们使用一个将承诺的不(财产不存在)与n/a(标准不适用或无法决定)区分开的提示,分别单独标注每个例子. 当法官们同意,他们的标签是最终的。 当他们不同意时,第三个型号(DeepSeek-V4)将示例标注在同一个提示下,而没有看到他们的判决,三个标签的大部分是最终的,如果三个都不同,则使用DeepSeek-V4的标签. C.8节将候选标签和最终标签与人类注释进行比较。

blocks.en: Each cross-domain benchmark is deterministically converted to VFM’s (context, target, criterion, label) form using a per-benchmark mapping described below.

blocks.en: We use PKU-Alignment/BeaverTails and keep one randomly chosen response per prompt. We assign 90% of prompts to training and dev and 10% to test, preserving the proportion of safe responses, and keep 10K training, 1K dev, and 1K test examples. The headline evaluation uses the single criterion “Does the text contain harmful or unsafe content?” Qwen3Guard-Gen-4B is trained on over 1.19M safety samples [ 70 ] , whereas we finetune on 10K BeaverTails samples.

blocks.en: We use argilla/ifeval-like-data , about 550K synthetic responses to IFEval-style instructions that either satisfy or violate their constraints. We sample 15K instruction-response pairs and split them into training, dev, and test sets (66%, 17%, and 17%). Our implementation of the IFEval checks labels each constraint, and we balance YES and NO within each constraint type where both occur. Each constraint is phrased as a criterion, such as “Does the response contain at least 100 words?” This gives 13,635 training, 3,403 dev, and 3,418 test pairs, with 1,504 distinct criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们使用argilla/ifeval-like-data, 对IFEval式指令的合成响应约550K, 我们抽查了1,5K个指示-应答对并分成培训、dev和测试组(66%、17%和17%)。 我们实施IFEval检查标记了每个制约,我们平衡了两种制约中的 " 是 " 和 " 否 " 。 每项限制都是作为一个标准提出的,例如“答复中是否至少包含100个字?” 这使13 635人接受了培训,3 403人接受了培训,3 418人接受了测试,有1 504个不同的标准。

blocks.en: We use Birchlabs/openai-prm800k-stepwise-critic , sample 35K rows, and keep steps rated correct ( + 1 +1 ) or incorrect ( − 1 -1 ). We split by problem (66%, 17%, and 17%), keeping all steps of a problem in the same split, and balance YES and NO. Every step is judged against the criterion “Is the reasoning in the text a valid and correct step toward solving the given math problem?” This gives 11,144 training, 2,700 dev, and 2,932 test steps. Our training labels are a small subset of PRM800K’s ∼ 800 {\sim}800 K labels, whereas the Qwen2.5-Math-7B-PRM800K baseline [ 69 ] is trained on the full dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Birchlabs/openai-prm800k-stepwise-critic ,样本为35K行,并保持标定步骤正确(+1+1)或不正确(−1-1). 我们按问题来划分(66%、17%和17%),将问题的所有步骤都放在同样的划分中,平衡“是”和“否”。 每个步骤都根据“案文中的推理是否是解决特定数学问题的有效和正确的步骤”这一标准来判断。 这提供了11,144个培训,2,700个dev和2,932个测试步骤。 我们的训练标签是PRM800K的\800 {\sim}800K标签的一小部分,而Qun2.5-Math-7B-PRM800K基线[69]则在完整的数据集上进行了训练。

blocks.en: We use lytang/LLM-AggreFact [ 56 ] , which combines 11 grounded fact-verification datasets. Each record pairs a document (the context) with a claim (the target), judged against the criterion “Is this claim factually supported by the provided document?” We evaluate on 3,000 records sampled from the official test split. Because most of its claims ( 77.9 % 77.9\% ) are supported, we report balanced accuracy. Unlike the other benchmarks, finetuning uses 10K examples from ANLI, VitaminC, and FEVER rather than LLM-AggreFact itself, so this column measures transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Lytang/LLM-AggreFact [56],它结合了11个基于事实的验证数据集. 每一份记录都根据“所提供的文件是否实际支持了这项索赔?” 标准,将一份文件(上下文)与索赔(目标)联系起来。 我们评估了从正式测试分拆中抽取的3000个记录. 由于它的大部分主张(77.9%的77.9\%)都得到了支持,因此我们报告了均衡的准确性. 与其他基准不同的是,微调使用来自ANLI,维生素C,以及FEVER的10K实例,而不是LLM-AggreFact本身,因此本列测量传输.

blocks.en: We use the official Stanford splits [ 29 ] unchanged, with 423 training, 61 dev, and 123 test contracts. Each contract is paired with the same 17 hypotheses, giving 7,191 training, 1,037 dev, and 2,091 test pairs. The contract is the context, and the criterion is “Does this agreement stipulate that: {hypothesis}?” The labels Entailment, Contradiction, and NotMentioned map to YES, NO, and n/a , respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们使用正式的斯坦福分数[29]不变,有423个训练,61个dev,123个测试合同. 每份合同都配对了相同的17个假说,给出了7,191个训练,1,037个dev,以及2,091个测试对. 合同是上下文,标准是“本协议是否规定:{伪 ? 标签分别是Yes、NO和n/a。

blocks.en: Table 13: Full-data cross-domain results (higher is better). Best external and best finetuned results per benchmark in bold . External baselines: 95% bootstrap CIs. Finetuned: mean ± \pm std over 3 seeds. LLM-judge cells score valid parses only. Under 1% of responses are unparsed, except for the direct Qwen3-4B judge on IFEval (10%), which often carries out the instruction instead of judging it.
blocks.zh: 表13:全数据跨域结果(较高更好). 每个基准的最佳外部和最佳微调结果以粗体表示。 外部基线:95%的靴子陷阱CI。 微调:平均值±\pm std 超过3个种子. LLM 判断单元格只获得有效的参数。 不到1%的回复没有解析,只有IFEval(10%)上的Qwen3-4B直接法官负责执行指令而不是判断。

blocks.en: C.2 Learning Curves
blocks.zh: C.2 学习曲线

blocks.en: For each 0.6B learning curve, we finetune each model at log-spaced budgets from n = 100 n{=}100 to the full training set under the uniform early-stopping recipe of Section B.3 . The full grid was run only at 0.6B, and each pretraining condition uses one checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 对于每个0.6B的学习曲线,我们按对数预算对每个模型进行微调,从n=100n{=}100到B.3节统一早停配方规定的全套培训。 全网仅在0.6B运行,每个预训条件都使用一个检查站.

blocks.en: C.3 Latency under Prefix-Cached Serving
blocks.zh: C.3 预选服务项下的延迟

blocks.en: The tree-mask layout is computationally equivalent to batched inference with a shared prefix cache, and an optimized serving stack can provide the same sharing through automatic prefix caching. Table 14 compares a one-token readout of the VFM backbone, which costs at least as much as the ternary head, with three judge interfaces under identical vLLM serving. A one-token judge on the base model reaches wall-clock parity with it, while generative judges remain slower.
blocks.zh: 树-mask布局在计算上相当于用共享前缀缓存进行批量推论,一个优化的服务堆栈可以通过自动前缀凸轮提供相同的共享. 表14比较了VFM主干线的一键读出,其成本至少与三角头一样高,在相同的vLLM下有三个裁判界面服务. 基模型上的一脚判官与它达到时钟对等,而基因判官则保持较慢的速度.

blocks.en: Table 14: Latency under vLLM automatic prefix caching (single H100, 4B models, bf16). Median wall-clock ms over 5 repeats after 2 warmups under identical serving configurations. The HuggingFace row repeats the vfm-pc row of Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 表14: vLLM 自动前缀凸起式(单H100,4B型,bf16)下的 Latency. 在相同的服务配置下,在两次热身之后,5个以上的中位点壁时数重复。 HuggingFace一行重复表6的vfm-pc一行.

blocks.en: C.4 Frozen-Backbone Linear Probe Baseline
blocks.zh: C.4 冻结-包骨线探测基线

blocks.en: Following Cunningham et al. [9] , we train per-task linear heads on top of frozen Qwen3 activations. We concatenate per-layer residual-stream activations at the final input token ( L ⋅ D = 92,160 L\cdot D=92{,}160 dims for Qwen3-4B; 28,672 28{,}672 for Qwen3-0.6B) and train K K heads per rule family: K = 15 K{=}15 binary heads for IFEval (the 15 of 25 IFEval constraint types with at least 100 training examples; rare types are dropped), 17 17 ternary heads for ContractNLI, and 1 1 binary head each for BeaverTails and PRM800K. Training uses AdamW with per-task hyperparameter sweeps and dev-tuned decision thresholds. The IFEval probe score averages the 15 trained probes only, excluding the 10 rare constraint types rather than counting them as failures.
blocks.zh: 追随康宁安等. [9],我们训练每个任务线性头 顶上冻结的Quen3激活。 我们在最后输入符上将每层残流激活(L ⋅ D = 92,160 L\cdot D = 92{,}160 dims for Qune3-4B;28,672 28{,}672 for Qune3-0.6B),并按规则家族训练K K头:K = 15 K{=}15 二进制头为IFEval(25个IFEval约束型中的15个,至少有100个训练实例;稀有型号被丢弃),17 17个三进制头为ContractNLI,1个二进制头为BaverTails和PRM800K. 训练使用 AdamW 具有每个任务超参数扫描和脱调决定阈值. IFEval探测器平均只得15个训练有素的探测器的分数,不包括十种罕见的制约类型,而不是算作故障.

blocks.en: The VFM beats the linear probe on every benchmark ( Table 13 ), so end-to-end finetuning recovers verdict-relevant signal that linear readouts of frozen Qwen3 features miss. The probe baseline also requires training and storing a separate head per criterion, whereas the VFM accepts arbitrary natural-language criteria at inference time.
blocks.zh: VFM在每个基准上击败线性探测器(表13),因此端到端微调恢复了判定相关的信号,即冷冻Quen3特性的线性读取缺失. 探针基线还需要每个标准训练并存储一个单独的头,而VFM在推断时接受任意的自然语言标准.

blocks.en: C.5 Zero-Shot Transfer (ROC-AUC)
blocks.zh: C.5 零热量转移(ROC-AUC)

blocks.en: Table 15 reports zero-shot, threshold-free ordering quality (ROC-AUC of the binary-renormalized p yes p^{\textsc{yes}} against the YES vs. NO label) for the pretrained models on all eight evaluation sets, with no benchmark-specific finetuning or threshold tuning. Seven sets are the benchmarks of Table 12 ; the eighth, InFoBench [ 49 ] , scores whether a response satisfies each decomposed instruction constraint and is included here because it is one of LMUnit’s evaluation benchmarks. On the three ternary benchmarks, AUC is computed over the YES/NO subset ( n/a records excluded). The lm-init rows are the untrained verbalizer-initialized head on the raw Qwen3 backbone ( Section 3.3 ), and isolate the zero-shot contribution of CriteriaBank pretraining. LMUnit-70B [ 51 ] is scored under its native unit-test prompt (without reference answers) on the same records, using its continuous score as the ranking statistic. We did not run it on the three ternary benchmarks, whose n/a -aware protocol has no LMUnit analogue.
blocks.zh: 表15报告所有八套评价中预先训练的模型的零射、无门槛定购质量(二进制的rOC-AUC p是 p^{\textsc{yes}} vs. NO标签),没有特定基准的微调或阈值调试。 七套是表12的基准;第八套是InFo Bench[49],评分一个答复是否满足了每个已分解的指令约束,并列入此处,因为它是LMUF的评价基准之一。 在三个三重基准上,AUC是按YES/NO子集计算的(不包括无记录)。 lm-init行是原始Quen3骨干(3.3节)上未经训练的口语化-初始化头部,并隔离标准银行预训的零镜头贡献. LMUnit-70B [51] 在同一记录的原生单位测试即时(无参考答案)下得分,使用连续得分作为排名统计. 我们没有在三个三重基准上运行它,它们的n/a-aware协议没有LMUnit模拟.

blocks.en: We highlight three observations. First, CriteriaBank pretraining is responsible for most of the zero-shot ordering ability (compare lm-init vs. the CriteriaBank-pretrained rows at both scales). Second, VFM-4B is the strongest of our models on 6 of 8 sets, with the largest gains over the unregularized VFM on InFoBench and governance. Third, the comparison with LMUnit-70B is split, consistent with divergent training distributions. LMUnit ranks better on LLM-AggreFact and IFEval, VFM-4B ranks better on InFoBench, PRM800K, and BeaverTails, at ∼ 17 × {\sim}17\times fewer parameters. Independent of accuracy, LMUnit’s size and one-generation-per-criterion interface make it costly to run as an online per-criterion verifier over large rule sets.
blocks.zh: 我们强调三项意见。 首先,标准Bank预训负责大多数零射定购能力(比较lm-init与标准Bank预训列两个比例尺). 第二,VFM-4B是我们在8套中的6套模型中最强的,相对于在InFo Bench和治理上的未正规化的VFM获得了最大的收益. 第三,与LMUnit-70B的比较是分开的,与不同的培训分配是一致的。 LMUnit在LLM-AggreFact和IFEval上的排名比较好,VFM-4B在InFo Bench,PRM800K和BeaverTails上的排名比较好,在QQ 17 × ~ ~ sim}17\时间的参数比较少. 不论准确性如何,LMUnit的大小和每条标码的一代接口使得作为每条标码的在线核查员在大型规则集上运行代价高昂。

blocks.en: Table 15: Zero-shot ROC-AUC (no finetuning, no threshold tuning). Ternary benchmarks (governance, ContractNLI, INSURE-Dial) are scored on their YES/NO subset. lm-init = verbalizer-initialized head on the raw backbone, no CriteriaBank pretraining. LMUnit-70B is run on the binary benchmarks only (see text).
blocks.zh: 表15:零镜头ROC-AUC(无微调,无门槛调). 三级基准(治理、ContractNLI、INSURE-Dial)在 " 是 " / " NO " 子集中得分。 lm-init = 粗体骨干上先期使用语言化头,无标准银行预训. LMUnit-70B只按二进制基准运行(见文本).

blocks.en: C.6 Governance: Construction and Audit
blocks.zh: C.6 治理:建筑和审计

blocks.en: We construct atomic criteria from regulatory source text in two passes. Claude Sonnet 4.6 first proposes ∼ 50 {\sim}50 candidate criteria per regulation, which Claude Opus 4.6 then consolidates into the 52 criteria of Section 4.1 . All criteria are positively phrased atomic yes/no questions. Several criteria are conditional: they ask about a property only if a precondition holds, and the absence of the precondition triggers n/a .
blocks.zh: 我们从监管来源文本中构建原子标准,分为两段。 克劳德·索内特(Claude Sonnet) 4.6首先提出了每条条例的 \ 50 {\sim}50 候选标准,克劳德·奥普斯 4.6 之后合并为第 4.1 节的 52 条标准. 所有标准都是正面的原子是/不是问题。 有几个标准是有条件的:它们只有在前提条件存在的情况下才询问财产,没有先决条件触发n/a.

blocks.en: The in-distribution evaluation pool comprises 80 synthetic interactions balanced across four domains (financial_advisory, data_collection, general_ai, out_of_scope; 20 each), split 25/75 by interaction (stratified by domain) into a dev set (20 interactions, 302 (interaction, criterion) records, used only for checkpoint selection, via a stratified 299-record subset per seed) and a held-out test set (60 interactions, 920 records, used for the reported numbers). A separate 130 interactions form the finetuning set, yielding 2,247 (interaction, criterion) examples. The transfer set adds 40 interactions from two held-out domains (healthcare and payment processing), yielding 951 (interaction, criterion) records. These records score both the 20 held-out transfer criteria (HIPAA and PCI-DSS) and in-distribution criteria whose applicability domains extend to the new interactions (496 of the 951 records).
blocks.zh: 分布式评价库包括80个合成相互作用,在四个领域(财务咨询、数据收集、一般_ai、范围外;各20个)之间保持平衡,通过相互作用(按域分类)将25/75分成一个Dev集(20个相互作用,302(相互作用,标准)记录,仅用于检查站选择,通过每个种子分级299个记录子集)和一个搁置式测试集(60个相互作用,920个记录,用于报告数字)。 一个单独的130个相互作用构成微调集,产生2 247个(相互作用,标准)实例。 这套转移增加了两个搁置领域(保健和付款处理)的40项互动,产生了951项(互动、标准)记录。 这些记录对20项搁置转让标准(HIPAA和PCI-DSS)和分配标准都进行了评分,其适用范围扩大到新的互动(951项记录中的496项)。

blocks.en: Each interaction carries a deterministic compliance_intent dictionary mapping every applicable criterion to a boolean. The drafting model assigns these flags at generation time, so the label is grounded in the construction process. Final YES/NO/ n/a labels are derived deterministically from compliance_intent together with conditional-criterion gating. At evaluation, models see only the criterion question, not the regulatory trigger conditions used to construct the labels, so finetuned models can learn the benchmark’s applicability conventions from training labels, whereas GPT-5.4 must infer them.
blocks.zh: 每个交互都带有一个决定性的遵守_intent字典,将每一个适用的标准映射到布尔。 起草模型在生成时会指定这些旗帜,因此标签以构建过程为基础. 最后的 " 是 " / " NO/n/a " 标签是确定性的,来源于遵守的意向以及有条件的标准。 在评价时,模型只看到标准问题,而不是用来构建标签的调节触发条件,因此微调的模型可以从培训标签中学习基准的适用性常规,而GPT-5.4必须推断出它们。

blocks.en: The drafted flags were independently audited by Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Auditor disagreements were adjudicated, and ambiguous criteria were reworded. The released corpus reflects 26 audit-driven label fixes (2.7% underlying error rate). Full audit prompts ship with the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 起草的旗帜由克劳德·奥普斯4.6和双子座3.1 Pro独立审核. 审计员的分歧得到裁定,模糊的标准被重新措辞。 公布的书目反映了26项审计驱动的标签修正(2.7%)。 全面审计促使船舶携带补充材料。

blocks.en: C.7 Governance: Human Validation
blocks.zh: C.7 治理:人类验证

blocks.en: We sampled 75 items from the governance benchmark, stratified across the three regulations represented (EU AI Act Art. 50: 24, GDPR Art. 13: 30, SEC Reg BI: 21). Three co-author annotators independently labeled each item in { yes , no , n/a } \{\textsc{yes},\textsc{no},\textsc{n/a}\} , given only the criterion text and the (context, target) pair, blind to the benchmark labels and to other annotators. We refer to Claude Sonnet 4.6, which drafted these labels, as the labeler. Round-1 annotators were not given the regulatory trigger specifications encoded in the labeler prompt. Round 2 supplies those triggers and tests whether residual disagreement is rubric-fixable.
blocks.zh: 我们从治理基准中抽查了75个项目,按三个条例分类(欧盟《大赦国际法》第50条:24条,GDPR第13条:30条,SEC Reg BI:21)。 三位共同作者在{是,否,n/a}\ textsc{yes},\textsc{no},\textsc{n/a}中独立标注了每个项目,只给标准文本和(context,靶)对,对基准标签和其他注释盲目. 我们把起草这些标签的Claude Sonnet 4.6当作标签。 第1轮注释器没有获得标签器提示器编码的调节触发规格。 第2轮提供了这些触发器,并测试残余分歧是否可以消除。

blocks.en: Table 16 reports pairwise agreement under three label projections. Under the binary yes vs. non- yes projection reported in Section 4.1 , human–labeler agreement is comparable to agreement between annotators. In a leave-one-out panel against the plurality of the other three, the labeler ranked second of four, with CIs overlapping substantially. Of the 18 labeler-vs-plurality disagreements, 12 (67%) follow one pattern: a human marks n/a (regulation does not apply) while the labeler marks no (obligation applies and is unmet). This trigger-vs-judgment split motivated round 2.
blocks.zh: 表16根据三个标签预测报告对等协议。 根据第4.1节中报告的二进制 " 是 " 与 " 非 " 的预测 " ,人与标签协议与注释者之间的协议相似。 在针对其他三个的多元性的一停置面板中,标注者在四位中排名第二,CI大相径庭. 在18个标签-vs-plaurity分歧中,12个(67%)遵循一种模式:人类标记n/a(不适用规定),而标签者标记no(适用义务,未履行义务)。 这个触发 -vs -判断 分裂动机 第2轮。

blocks.en: Table 16 : Round-1 pairwise agreement on the 75-item governance subset under three label projections. The yes vs. ¬ \neg yes projection collapses the n/a / no distinction and is the one reported in Section 4.1 , so only it shows 95% CIs (Wilson on agreement, bootstrap on κ \kappa ).

Of the 38 round-1 contested items, the 35 without a unanimous round-1 human-vs-labeler disagreement were independently re-labeled by all three annotators, with regulatory trigger and obligation conditions inline, the same scaffolding the labeler prompt encoded.
blocks.zh: 在38个回合-1的争议项目中,35个没有一致的回合-1人文-vs-标签者分歧的标注被所有3个注释者独立地重新标注,规范触发和义务条件内在,同样的脚手架将标注者迅速编码.

blocks.en: With the rubric, the annotators largely agree with one another on the 35 contested items (ternary κ \kappa of 0.74 0.74 , 0.73 0.73 , and 0.91 0.91 for the three pairs) and moderately with the labeler ( 0.57 0.57 – 0.61 0.61 ).

5/75 items have unanimous post-rubric human disagreement with the labeler ( 6.7 % 6.7\% , 95% Wilson CI [ 2.9 , 14.7 ] [2.9,14.7] ); four more have post-rubric 2-of-3 plurality disagreement. Counting these too gives a candidate-error rate of 12.0 % 12.0\% (95% Wilson CI [ 6.4 , 21.3 ] [6.4,21.3] ).
blocks.zh: 5/75物品与标注者有一致的后鲁博主义人类分歧(6.7% 6.7\%,95% Wilson CI [2.9,14.7] [2.9,14.7]);另外4件则有后鲁博主义2·3多元分歧. 计算这些数字后,候选人比率为12.0%(12.0%)(95%的Wilson CI [6.4,21.3] [6.4,21.3])。

blocks.en: C.8 CriteriaBank: Human Validation
blocks.zh: C.8 标准库:人类验证

blocks.en: Human validation on CriteriaBank replicates the protocol of Section C.7 on a 75-item sample drawn from CriteriaBank’s broad-coverage subset, stratified across the three ternary streams (Stream A: 25, Stream B: 26, Stream C: 24). The same three co-author annotators labeled each item in { yes , no , n/a } \{\textsc{yes},\textsc{no},\textsc{n/a}\} under the same blind protocol. We compare their labels with two model label sources: the generator’s candidate labels (“teacher” below) and the final judge-panel labels ( Section B.1 ). Unlike governance, CriteriaBank teacher prompts did not encode domain-specific trigger conditions. The criteria are aspect-style yes/no questions about target text content (e.g., “Did the agent call a tool?”).
blocks.zh: 人类对标准银行的验证复制了C.7节关于75项样本的协议,该协议取自标准银行的广覆盖子集,分层分为三条三条三条溪流(Stream A:25, Stream B:26, Stream C:24)。 同一三位共同作者的注释家在{是,否,n/a}\ textsc{yes},\ textsc{no},\ textsc{n/a}中将每个项目标注在同一盲协议下. 我们将它们的标签与两个模型标签来源进行比较:发电机候选人的标签(下文 " 教师 " )和最后的法官-小组标签(B.1节)。 与治理不同,标准Bank 老师提示没有编码特定域的触发条件. 标准是方面式的“是/否”关于目标文本内容的问题(例如,“代理人是否称工具?” )。

blocks.en: INSURE-Dial Task 2 [ 30 ] evaluates each call with a single structured query that fills a fixed schema of per-phase compliance fields, such as “Did the assistant ask the user to confirm coverage during the coverage-check phase?” We instead derive 9 atomic criterion templates from the dataset’s annotations, giving 6 or 9 templates per call (the three drug-specific templates repeat for each drug discussed) and 417 records in total across the 50 test calls (47.5% YES, 18.9% NO, 33.6% n/a ). Seven templates correspond to schema fields and yield 317 records. The other two, greeting (‘‘Did the assistant provide a greeting?’’) and reference-number elicitation (‘‘Did the assistant ask the user for a reference number?’’), have no schema field, so the source paper’s protocol cannot score them. For the GPT-5.4 paper-protocol baseline, we use the source paper’s code, 2 2 2 https://github.com/interactly-aimon/insuredial-dataframer-eacl-2026 prompt, and schema.

blocks.en: For the headline results ( Table 4 ), each model is trained for a fixed 20 epochs (3 seeds), and we select epochs by 5-fold cross-validation over the 50 real calls, split by call. For each fold, we select the epoch by accuracy on the other 40 calls and use it to predict the 10 held-out calls. Selecting on macro-F1 instead changes no mean accuracy by more than 0.4 points. We select on real calls because macro-F1 on the synthetic dev split saturates after about 3 epochs, while accuracy on real calls keeps improving.

It too rarely answers n/a and labels most n/a records no , whereas GPT-5.4 with the same prompt labels most of them correctly.

blocks.en: C.10 DynaBench: Details
blocks.zh: C.10 Dyna Bench: 细节

blocks.en: DynaBench rules are natural-language assertions, sometimes compound (e.g., “When the user asks X X , do Y Y and otherwise refuse”). Before training and evaluation, GPT-5.4 translates each rule, from its text alone, into one or more atomic questions phrased so that YES means a violation, with one question per branch of a compound rule. For example, “Never use emojis” becomes “Did the agent use emojis?” The translator never sees traces or labels, and its translations average 1.52 1.52 questions per rule. For training, each question inherits its rule’s label.
blocks.zh: Dyna Bench规则是自然语言的断言,有时是复合语(例如,“当用户询问X X时,Do Y,否则拒绝”)。 在培训和评价之前,GPT-5.4将每个规则从单文本中翻译成一个或多个原子问题,这样就意味着违反,每个复合规则分支有一个问题。 例如,“永远不要使用emojis”变成“制剂是否使用emojis?” 翻译者从未见过痕迹或标签,其翻译平均每条规则1.52 1.52个问题. 对于训练,每个问题都继承其规则的标签。

blocks.en: To measure how much the VFM relies on decomposition, we keep one DynaBench-finetuned 4B checkpoint fixed (from an earlier configuration without KL regularization) and replace each rule’s atomic questions with a single whole-rule question. Trace-level FAIL-F1 drops from 0.850 0.850 to 0.727 0.727 , partly because several questions give more chances to detect a violation. We release the translation prompts and the translated criteria.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量VFM在多大程度上依赖于分解,我们保留了一个Dyna Bench-finetuned 4B检查点固定(从一个没有KL正规化的早期配置),并且用一个单一的全规则问题来取代每个规则的原子问题. 追踪级FAIL-F1从0.850 0.850降至0.727 0.727,部分原因是几个问题为发现违反情况提供了更多的机会。 我们发布了翻译提示和翻译标准.

blocks.en: A trace is predicted FAIL if any of its questions has a violation probability, renormalized over YES and NO, above the dev-selected threshold. Every FAIL trace in DynaBench violates exactly one rule. To localize it, we score each rule by its highest question-level violation probability and check whether the violated rule ranks first (top-1) or among the top three (top-3). Top-1 localization is 97.6 % 97.6\% for VFM-4B, and top-3 is 100 % 100\% for every model and seed, so the cascade’s top three always include the violated rule. Replacing them with three random rules drops the cascade to 0.675 0.675 F1. The cascade passes the raw text of these rules to the Gemma judge, the input format under which that judge is strongest ( Table 5 ). Because DynaBench rules always apply to their traces, renormalization costs nothing here. In n/a -heavy settings it can rank an inapplicable criterion above a true violation, as the next paragraph shows.

blocks.en: These domains are only a slice of the regulatory surface a small-business advisory chatbot must respect. To estimate the broader scope, we used an LLM (Gemini 3 Pro) to enumerate candidate legal and governance frameworks for the deployment, running multiple passes across regulatory categories and jurisdictional layers (NYC, New York State, and federal) and deduplicating across passes. Single-pass enumeration yielded 21 21 frameworks; multi-pass deduplication surfaced 141 141 . We then drew a random sample of 30 30 frameworks and asked the model to enumerate provisions within each, finding an average of roughly 15 15 provisions per framework; extrapolating to all 141 141 yields roughly 2,100 2{,}100 atomic provisions in total. A targeted recovery check confirmed that the full set of documented violation areas extracted from the reporting was surfaced; single-pass enumeration missed five of those documented areas.

blocks.en: This roughly 115 115 -word fragment yields six criteria, many of which might be further decomposed, a density of about one criterion per twenty words. If this density were representative of the full system prompt, a several-thousand-word prompt would imply hundreds of atomic behavioral rules. The Claude Code or Cursor harness adds further tool-use protocols, project conventions, memory entries, and user-specific instructions on top, expanding the per-session deployment surface to > > 15,000 words.
